Name: `SET_FAKE_BATTERY_LEVEL`
Description: Set fake battery level. Unset to disable.

Name: `SET_FAKE_CHARGING_STATUS`
Description: Set fake charging status. Unset to disable.

Name: `androidboot.fake_battery`
Description: Set fake battery information by AOSP. Unset to disable.
Notes:
You can check [BatteryMonitor.cpp](https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/+/android-latest-release:system/core/healthd/BatteryMonitor.cpp), search for `ro.boot.fake_battery` to know which value they are trying to fake.
As of 30/08/2025, the value is 42% battery at 42.4°C
